Law Enforcement Officers are 54% more likely to die by suicide than those in any other occupation. 
 
On #NationalLawEnforcementSuicideAwarenessDay, we honor & remember the officers lost to suicide. If you or someone you know is struggling with mental health, call 988. https://t.co/dd7pfPdEWN

Happy 37th Anniversary @MoffittNews!

Since opening its doors in 1986, Moffitt Cancer Center has delivered life-changing treatment to thousands of patients and led the way for innovative research in healthcare. Here’s to many more years of changing lives! https://t.co/w71JHAyDkH

As the Winter Strawberry Capital of the world, #FL15 is home to countless agriculture producers & specialty crop growers.

I am proud to support the TEMP Act, which provides much-needed stability & coverage for Florida’s growers for crop damages caused by freezing temperatures.

🚨 Today is the final day of the Medicare open enrollment period!
 
 Visit https://t.co/RETVeuc5rb or call 1-800-MEDICARE for more information.

Our nation’s military heroes deserve to have access to the best healthcare and resources available. 
 
The new state-of-the-art James A. Haley VA Mental Health Center in Temple Terrace will have a tremendous impact on the tens of thousands of veterans who call #FL15 home. https://t.co/7HouZdmq2F

This #WorldCancerDay, I recognize and stand with the patients and families across the nation who have been impacted.

Honored to have @MoffittNews, a world-class research and treatment center, right here in #FL15. Advancing innovative & quality care is crucial to finding a cure. https://t.co/ihsgkcY3bE

I am proud to have secured $2.4 million towards @MoffittNews' BioEngineering research projects which will have tremendous impacts on the future of cancer treatment.

Thank you for leading the way for innovative care and groundbreaking research throughout #FL15 and beyond. https://t.co/CsXaaUPjBM

#MentalHealthAwarenessMonth serves as an opportunity to support our loved ones, friends, and neighbors while raising awareness for mental health resources.

Your mental health and emotional well-being matter. If you or someone you know are in need, resources are available. https://t.co/giEVLngaq3

It is an absolute honor to be presented with the Moffitt Momentum Award.

Thank you, @MoffittNews, for your efforts to provide world-class treatment and research to our community and beyond. I am proud to be a champion for Moffitt Cancer Center and will continue to support policies that promote innovation in the cancer field.

In America, families should be empowered to make healthcare decisions that best meet their families’ needs.

This week, I co-sponsored H.R. 6033, the SPEAK Act, and H.R. 4758, Accelerating Kids’ Access to Care Act, both of which will expand all Floridians’ and Americans’ access to quality, affordable, and reliable health care.

Residents should be prepared for flooding and other impacts from soon-to-be Hurricane Helene.

#FL15–remember hurricane season is not over until November 30th. You should ensure your family, home, and business remain ready.

🚪 Develop an evacuation plan
🔋 Assemble disaster supplies 
🏠 Get an insurance check and document your possessions
📋 Handwrite a communication plan and a list of contacts
⛑️ Keep emergency resources handy

As always, my team and I are here to help. Visit https://t.co/IVzE87WSvD for more resources.

All Americans deserve to have access to reliable, efficient, and affordable health care.

I am committed this #NationalRuralHealthDay to reducing barriers and expanding access within the healthcare field in #Fl15 and throughout the country. https://t.co/FmpejEptx2

My bill, the READY Account Act, will enable American families to invest in recovery projects, much like a Health Savings Account, to help mitigate home repair costs after a natural disaster.

More from my interview this week with @BN9 ⬇️ https://t.co/kheiXxi4yG

On #WorldCancerDay, we remember loved ones who have lost their fight to this disease, celebrate the survivors, and continue to support those currently fighting.

May we renew our commitment to raising awareness for the detection, prevention, and treatment of this terrible disease.

It has only been one month since President Trump took office and illegal border crossings have dropped 94% compared to last year.

This administration is committed to putting American's safety first—this is what leadership looks like!

https://t.co/vScrsPqZNX

It’s always a pleasure to meet with @MoffittNews President and CEO, Dr. Patrick Hwu.

This week in D.C., we discussed expanding cancer care and research through new policy initiatives as well as the intersection between AI and healthcare. We are fortunate to have an incredible, world-renowned cancer research and treatment center in #FL15.

A new report shows illegal immigrants’ healthcare cost Florida taxpayers $660 MILLION in 2024—including $64 million in Hillsborough County alone.

Taxpayer dollars should not be spent on illegal immigrants. I’m fighting to put an end to this absurdity and protect your hard-earned dollars.

https://t.co/5UT11DXlLk

I know that Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security are an indispensable lifeline for many.

I am committed to finding and eliminating the waste, fraud, and abuse of these important programs to ensure they can continue to support the Americans who need it most. https://t.co/w3wMzk79gd

🏠 #FL15 homeowners—Tampa’s Homeowner Disaster Assistance Program is now open.

If you need assistance with insurance deductibles, mortgages, or the cost of repairs due to hurricane damage, visit https://t.co/3DqT5tgIa6 for more information.

From healthcare to emergency services, reliable internet is essential to modern life. When broadband lines are damaged or stolen, entire communities pay the price.

This is why I introduced the Stopping the Theft and Destruction of Broadband Act—a bipartisan bill that imposes stronger penalties on those who intentionally damage or steal broadband lines.

Read more: https://t.co/6OGzOAi0ga

May is Mental Health Awareness Month. Normalizing the conversation around mental health is how we can break the stigma.

This month, take the time to check in on your loved ones, educate yourself on the resources available, and prioritize your mental health. https://t.co/6pA2t8grE9
